notes.title: NEW HUGE UPDATE!!! Version 2.0 - All NEW Dynamic Blinds Integrated, Texas Hold'em/Blackjack Bracelets, Blackjack/Roulette AI, New Watches and Customization Options, Slots Updated, Holiday Decorations:
notes.content:
Happy Holidays to all!

[h1]All NEW Dynamic Blinds Integrated:[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RIj48b7ra3bhzxc2Pz/giphy.gif[/img]
At Texas Hold 'em, you can change the whole table's blind, and thus the feel of the game. Select various blinds at the start of a game and then watch the blind automatically upgrade higher and higher after enough game time has elapsed.

[h1]Texas Hold'em/Blackjack Bracelets:[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/aIS9vF3FjKHqwAjvSA/giphy.gif[/img]
Show off your experience with the all new Game Bracelets. With enough wins, you can earn your right to show off.

[h1]Blackjack/Roulette AI:[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/c048388e766257c540247f65a5e827c28a831e99.jpg[/img]
There's always someone to play with now, introducing the all new AI for Blackjack and Roulette which deliver a competitive and rewarding experience. The best part is they'll already be betting when you enter the Casino. They won't mind if you wish to step in and take their place though.

[h1]New Watches and Customization Options:[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1AfbGXSdKErWTuKrs6/giphy.gif[/img]
- Players can now customize their Watch to their liking in the Hand Menu's Watch Customization page (Main Menu -> Store -> Watch Customization). This page allows players to change their Watch's: visibility, location to right or left hand, case, face, hands, or leather.
- We've added additional Watch pieces to the Black and Gold Watches that are given away for free to players who already own those watches. There are 2 new Watches with fresh pieces and now with watch customization there is a total of 625 new possible unique designs.

[h1]Slots Updated:[/h1] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/2719b4c98ede8c0079b2397bb38aa8d3628df2d8.jpg[/img]
The loosest Slots in VR just got looser, we've increased the odds of winning, and they have a new visual look too!

[h1]Holiday Decorations:[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/509613657976af15bc22e5e7570e7513c37b2bd8.jpg[/img]

- Shooting Range spawns Ornaments for the holiday season.

[h1]Version 2.0 Update also includes:[/h1]
- Minor bug fixes/improvements.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE!!! Version 1.09 - Beta Gym Release & MORE User Requests fulfilled
notes.content:
Earlier this week...




Have you ever lost a tough hand and wished you had a place to go and punch out all your frustration?  Well now you do!

We are excited to announce that Social Club VR : Casino nights has opened up… The Boxing Gym.  We know that many of our users have been dying for another space to explore. All you have to do is get in the elevator and go up to a whole new level of fun.  Now when you lose a tough hand you can head to the elevator and go punch out your frustration, and even gain Chips while you do it! 

[b]Features of this new Space:[/b]

[h1]Heavy Bags -[/h1] Work the Heavy Bag in a single or multi player competition designed to test your reflexes and skill.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/dcd44b19db9954a813cac134b82ab074d12d098a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Speed Bags -[/h1] How fast can you move those hands?  And it’s not just purely about speed… with this challenge timing is everything.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/e923c70627659b05457efb8762e7877d0538d7e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Boxing Ring -[/h1] Grab a buddy and head to the ring for a 3, 5, or 7 round boxing extravaganza!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/b27496fdbaae6408d0ed4b70f142497027ff1543.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weights –[/h1] Why not pick up some 45lb dumbbells and work out those biceps?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32829996/dfdc8b9c63ea38a722a139ccf40dfc033f054ee4.jpg[/img]

Wonder what your friends are doing in the Casino while you are boxing? Turn on the Large Screen Display and get a birds eye view of everything happening in the Casino.

And while you’re in the gym, enjoy some sweet tunes while you work up a sweat! 


[h1]Version 1.09 Update also includes:[/h1]

- Texas Hold ’em: Club Chips are now more dynamic when you throw them in the pot before being cleaned up into nice stacks.
- Added "Game Results Voice Overs" (located in the Hand Menu’s “Gameplay/Graphics Settings” page). When set to OFF, the Win/Tied/Lost voice over sfx will not play at Casino games.
- Updated Gameplay Settings UI.
- Kicked players - if playing a game they will be kicked when they finish.
- Blackjack splitting a pair of aces bug fixed.
- Improved Stat/Achievement Tracking.
